title: feat(tools): a form mill kind with roundover, cove, ogee, V-groove and bead presets
body:
Stacked on #3929 (D1, taper tip form). The D2 commits only: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/compare/f2fff2b3f1ef4586f09d0e8db96d1c6760ebc62c...qsmits:Camcraft:issue/3369-form-mill-presets

Plan step D2 of the tool library redesign (#3663).

## What changed

- **New kind `ToolKind::FormMill`** (file word `form_mill`). Its cutting edge is the outline in the new field `Tool::form` (`FormSpec`: points `[z, r, arc]` from the tip up, `pilot_len`, and the preset that wrote the points). New module `crates/tools/src/form_mill.rs` with `form_mill_presets.rs`.
- **Presets** write the outline from router bit catalogue numbers:
  - roundover: radius, pilot radius, cutting height;
  - cove: radius, pilot radius, cutting height;
  - ogee: two radii, the step, pilot radius, cutting height;
  - V-groove: included angle, tip radius, cutting diameter, cutting height (no pilot);
  - bead: radius, step (the quirk), pilot radius, cutting height.
- **Pilot band**: the segments up to `pilot_len` (the tip face and the bearing side) are non-cutting in the meridian. The bearing has its own radius.
- **The outline sets the diameter and the flute length.** `is_sane` refuses a disagreement by name and states the correct numbers. The editor and MCP call `Tool::settle_form`. A file load does not repair a disagreement: it refuses it.
- **Undercut refused by name**: an outline whose radius narrows upward is refused with a reference to #896.
- `Tool::meridian` and `Tool::profile` read the outline. `profile` flattens the arcs on the outside of the cutter (the spun-profile law), so the collision band stack is never smaller than the form. `cutter_fit::same_shape` compares the form, and the operation stamp hashes the whole outline and the pilot.
- **Operation doors**: the form mill is in the `CONE` family, so `no_orphan_tool_kinds` stays green. `tool_gate` refuses it by name for each operation (creation, edit, re-tool, generation and post). The 2D Chamfer refusal names the edge form work (#896). No refusal suggests a form mill, and no operation offers one.
- **Catalog**: `FM-RO-R6`, `FM-RO-R0250IN`, `FM-CV-R6`, `FM-CV-R0250IN`, `FM-VG-90-12`, `FM-VG-90-0500IN` (roundover, cove and 90-degree V-groove, in mm and inch). The catalog states the preset; the reader writes the points. The inch roundover and cove state their true inch numbers: a 3/16 in pilot, `0.1875 * 25.4` = 4.7625 mm, and a 11/16 in flute length, 17.4625 mm (not rounded values). The sanity law compares the outline with the diameter and flute length with a slack of `AGREE` = 1e-6 mm (1 nm); the holder stack test compares the spun stack with the cylinder with a slack of 1e-9 mm, not exact float equality (a 17.4625 mm flute under a 32 mm shank gives a 25.000000000000007 mm holder band).
- **Editor**: "Form mill" in the type list; a "Form preset" list (a drawn outline or one of the five presets), the preset number rows and the pilot length (`tool_form_mill_row.rs`, called from `kind_rows()`); diameter and flute length are shown, not typed. The shape window's Draw cutter view names the form in place of a tip number. New original icon `tool-form-mill` (SVG master and PNG).
- **MCP**: `add_tool` and `edit_tool` take `form` (preset or drawn points, and `pilot_len`); descriptions, `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` and the `camcraft-mcp` skill row updated. The cutter tools read the form through `Tool::profile`; a diameter edit that leaves the outline is refused by name.
- Decisions: `docs/decisions/3369-form-mill-presets.md`. The main decision: the outline lives on `Tool`, not only in `ToolCutter`, because the catalog, the meridian, `Tool::profile` and the sanity law see only `Tool`.

## Version steps

None. Only the `form_mill` kind states a `form`, and each older build (D1 included) refuses the unknown kind word by name, so it cannot read a form mill as another tool. A project or library without a form mill is unchanged. The library test pins that a form mill library stays under `TIP_FORM_VERSION`. Not marked breaking: this follows the additive kind words of #1444 (T-slot, keyseat, dovetail, lollipop).

## Readings

- Catalogue diameters from the meridian: FM-RO-R6 25.0 mm, FM-RO-R0250IN 25.4 mm, FM-CV-R6 25.0 mm, FM-CV-R0250IN 25.4 mm, FM-VG-90-12 12.0 mm, FM-VG-90-0500IN 12.7 mm.
- Ogee R4 / R3, step 1.5, pilot radius 6.35: cuts at radius 14.85 mm. Bead R6.35, step 1.6, pilot radius 6.35: 14.3 mm.
- Dialog: a roundover radius edit from 6 to 8 mm gives diameter 29.0 mm after Apply (one undo step).

## Pinning tests

- `camcraft-tools` lib: `form_mill::tests::{each_preset_meets_its_catalogue_radius, the_pilot_band_does_not_cut, bad_preset_numbers_are_refused_by_name, an_undercut_outline_is_refused_by_name, the_outline_owns_the_diameter_and_the_kind_owns_the_form, the_side_view_never_falls_inside_the_form, a_number_edit_keeps_the_drawn_form, the_wire_form_round_trips}`, `catalog_asset_tests::the_catalog_form_mills_cut_at_their_catalogue_diameter` (pins the true inch pilot and flute length and the point count of each preset: a sharp V-groove has two points, the tip on the axis and the top of the cone), `spun::tests::a_parametric_holder_stacks_as_the_cylinder` (renamed from `..._bit_identically_...`; slack 1e-9 mm). The `#[test]` count does not change.
- `camcraft-app` `tool_law`: `no_orphan_tool_kinds` (green with the new kind), `form_mill_is_refused_by_every_door`.
- `camcraft-app` `tool_library`: `a_form_mill_round_trips_with_its_outline` (library file, project file byte for byte, `ChangeTool` keeps the outline, refused diameter, preset without points).
- `camcraft-app` `mcp_edit_tool`: `add_and_edit_tool_take_a_form_mill_preset`.
- `camcraft-ui` lib: `tool_library_editor::{the_form_mill_presets_show, a_form_mill_profile_tab_names_its_form}`, `tool_form_mill_row::tests::{each_preset_seeds_a_sane_tool, another_kind_clears_the_form}`.

## Windows gate (winbuild, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1`, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=5`)

Final head `4b1e00121cc1380c0a2476d4777eeebeca1e55a6` (contains `origin/main` `02d05bc1c`). Log: `C:\camcraft-logs\gate-3946-4b1e00121.log` (its `head` line and `head-at-end` line both name `4b1e00121cc1380c0a2476d4777eeebeca1e55a6`).

- Full `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` (D1 + D2): **157 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 33.8 min**, gate exit 0 (`gate-logs/quick-20261125-002517`). The plan includes `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: ok.
- `tools suites: lib`: 143 passed, 0 failed (with `the_catalog_form_mills_cut_at_their_catalogue_diameter`, `a_parametric_holder_stacks_as_the_cylinder`, `each_preset_meets_its_catalogue_radius`, `the_pilot_band_does_not_cut`).
- Strict clippy `-p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` on the same head: clean (exit 0).
- D2 alone (`--base` the #3929 head): 139 steps in the dry run. The `Tool` field touches the struct literals in motion and app tests, which widens the plan.
- P4: no heavy step. Light lane not run.

## Not exercised

- No generator, simulation or post reads the form outline: each operation refuses a form mill.
- A free outline is drawn only through MCP `edit_tool`; the editor has no point table for the form.
- No physical router run. The Mac was not used for builds.

### Before and after (review of `4b1e00121`, finding 2)

These images are headless egui_kittest renders on macOS, cropped to the window.
"Before" is upstream main `ea19c3f21`. Main has no form mill, so it shows the nearest tool: the catalogue router bit `Router up-cut 1/4 in`.
"After" is head `5b5cba768` with the catalogue form mill `FM-RO-R6`.

| Tool tab, before (main) | Tool tab, after (form mill rows) |
|---|---|
| ![tool tab before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6d0d01d8ccbc8a1cec25fbc8824a37ac07b8569f/pr-3946/before-main-tool-tab.png) | ![tool tab after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6d0d01d8ccbc8a1cec25fbc8824a37ac07b8569f/pr-3946/after-tool-tab.png) |

| Draw cutter, before (main) | Draw cutter, reviewed head `4b1e00121` | Draw cutter, after |
|---|---|---|
| ![draw cutter before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6d0d01d8ccbc8a1cec25fbc8824a37ac07b8569f/pr-3946/before-main-draw-cutter.png) | ![draw cutter reviewed head](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6d0d01d8ccbc8a1cec25fbc8824a37ac07b8569f/pr-3946/reviewed-head-draw-cutter.png) | ![draw cutter after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/6d0d01d8ccbc8a1cec25fbc8824a37ac07b8569f/pr-3946/after-draw-cutter.png) |

At the reviewed head, the Draw cutter view had editable `cutter Ø` and `flutes` cells for a form mill. At the new head it shows the two values as text.

## Goldens moved

None. No recorded `.cl`, `.cnc` or snapshot file changed.

Process change: yes (the `camcraft-mcp` skill row for `add_tool`).

Changelog: New form mill tool kind with roundover, cove, ogee, V-groove and bead presets and an optional pilot bearing; the catalog has roundover, cove and V-groove bits in mm and inch. Operations refuse a form mill by name until they read its shape.

Effort: high
